hypotheses.construction_plan: Define F(theta)=polygamma(0,theta). The term polygamma(0,z) is F(theta) specialized to theta=z. The term polygamma(1,z) is dF/dtheta specialized to theta=z, using the exact derivative identity d/dtheta polygamma(0,theta)=polygamma(1,theta).
required_assumptions: polygamma(0,theta) is differentiable and d/dtheta polygamma(0,theta)=polygamma(1,theta)
hypotheses.rationale: The two subexpressions are consecutive orders of the polygamma function; the second is the derivative of the first with respect to the argument z. This is a structural derivative family generated from digamma.
